AD - Port Scanning.description: Detect burst port scans targeting Domain Controller ports.

commands.description: Detect burst connections to AD ports from single source.
commands.command: event.category: network AND destination.port: (88 OR 135 OR 389 OR 445 OR 636 OR 3268 OR 3269) AND network.direction: inbound | stats count() by source.ip | where count > 50

commands.description: EQL — detect rapid AD port sweep.
commands.command: sequence by source.ip with maxspan=30s [network where destination.port in (88,389,445,636) and network.packets < 3] with runs=20

AD - Port Scanning.tuning: Tune connection rate threshold based on environment. Whitelist security scanners, monitoring agents (Nessus, Qualys). Alert on internal-to-internal scanning first.

AD - SMB Enumeration.description: Detect null sessions, share enumeration, and enum4linux-style tools.

commands.description: Detect anonymous SMB null session (Event 4624 Type 3, empty user).
commands.command: event.code: 4624 AND winlog.event_data.LogonType: 3 AND winlog.event_data.AccountName: "-" AND winlog.event_data.AuthenticationPackageName: "NTLM"

commands.description: Detect rapid SMB share enumeration — Event 5140.
commands.command: event.code: 5140 | stats dc(winlog.event_data.ShareName) as shares, count() by source.ip, winlog.event_data.SubjectUserName | where shares > 5

AD - SMB Enumeration.tuning: Exclude DC-to-DC replication traffic and legitimate backup tools. Alert on workstation-to-workstation SMB enumeration — highly unusual.

AD - LDAP Enumeration & BloodHound.description: Detect high-volume LDAP queries from BloodHound, ldapdomaindump, windapsearch.

commands.description: Detect high-volume LDAP queries from single account (Event 1644).
commands.command: event.code: 1644 | stats count() by winlog.event_data.AccountName, source.ip | where count > 100
event.code: 1644 AND winlog.event_data.SearchFilter: (*msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo* OR *trustedDomain* OR *msDS-GroupMSAMembership*)

commands.description: Detect SharpHound or ldapdomaindump process execution.
commands.command: process.command_line: (*SharpHound* OR *bloodhound* OR *ldapdomaindump* OR *windapsearch*)

AD - LDAP Enumeration & BloodHound.tuning: Whitelist Azure AD Connect, SCCM, and backup solutions. Alert on LDAP queries from endpoints (not servers) with high object counts.

AD - Password Spraying.description: Detect low-and-slow password spraying across many accounts.

commands.description: Multiple failed logons across many accounts from one IP.
commands.command: event.code: 4625 AND winlog.event_data.LogonType: 3 | stats dc(winlog.event_data.TargetUserName) as unique_users by source.ip | where unique_users > 10

commands.description: Kerberos pre-auth failures across many accounts (Event 4771).
commands.command: event.code: 4771 AND winlog.event_data.FailureCode: "0x18" | stats dc(winlog.event_data.TargetUserName) as unique_users by source.ip | where unique_users > 5

AD - Password Spraying.tuning: Tune detection thresholds against Elastic baseline auth failure rates. Exclude service accounts, health check endpoints, and known scanners. Alert on accounts hitting Smart Lockout first.

AD - Kerberoasting.description: Detect TGS requests using RC4 encryption for offline cracking.

commands.description: RC4 Kerberos TGS request for non-machine accounts (Event 4769).
commands.command: event.code: 4769 AND winlog.event_data.TicketEncryptionType: "0x17" AND NOT winlog.event_data.ServiceName: (*$*)

commands.description: Rubeus or GetUserSPNs via process telemetry.
commands.command: process.command_line: (*Rubeus* AND *kerberoast* OR *GetUserSPNs*)

AD - Kerberoasting.tuning: Tune alert thresholds based on your environment's baseline. Whitelist known legitimate tools and service accounts. Correlate with complementary Elastic data sources for context.

commands.description: GetNPUsers or Rubeus asreproast via process events.

commands.description: DHCP starvation — flood of DISCOVER from unique MACs.
commands.command: network.protocol: dhcp AND dhcp.type: discover | stats dc(source.mac) as macs by bin(@timestamp, 1m) | where macs > 20

commands.description: Rogue DHCP server — OFFER from unauthorized IP.
commands.command: network.protocol: dhcp AND dhcp.type: offer AND NOT source.ip: ({authorized_dhcp_servers})

LNX - Persistence (Linux).description: Detect Linux persistence via cron, systemd, PAM, authorized_keys, rc.local.

commands.description: Cron directory write by non-cron process.
commands.command: event.module:auditd AND file.path:("/etc/cron.d/*" OR "/etc/cron.daily/*" OR "/etc/cron.hourly/*" OR "/var/spool/cron/*") AND NOT process.name:(cron OR anacron OR apt OR dpkg)

commands.description: New systemd service unit file created.
commands.command: event.module:auditd AND file.path:("/etc/systemd/system/*.service" OR "/lib/systemd/system/*.service") AND NOT process.name:(apt OR dpkg OR rpm OR systemd)
event.module:auditd AND file.path:"/etc/pam.d/*" AND NOT process.name:(apt OR dpkg)
event.module:auditd AND file.path:"*/.ssh/authorized_keys" AND event.type:change
event.module:auditd AND process.name:(insmod OR modprobe) AND NOT process.args:(nvidia OR vmware OR vbox OR overlay)
event.module:auditd AND file.path:("*/.bashrc" OR "*/.profile" OR "/etc/profile.d/*.sh") AND NOT process.name:(bash OR dash OR sh)

LNX - Reverse Shell & Tunneling.description: Detect reverse shells, tunneling tools, and unauthorized lateral movement on Linux.

commands.description: Bash reverse shell via /dev/tcp or pipe.
commands.command: event.module:auditd AND process.args:("/dev/tcp/*" OR ">&/dev/tcp*" OR "bash -i" OR "0<&")
event.module:auditd AND process.name:(nc OR ncat OR netcat) AND process.args:"-e"
event.module:auditd AND process.name:(socat OR chisel OR ligolo OR pwncat OR sshuttle)
event.module:auditd AND process.name:ssh AND process.args:("-D*" OR "-L*" OR "-R*")
event.module:syslog AND message:*sshd* AND message:"Accepted" AND NOT source.ip:(10.* OR 192.168.* OR 172.16.*)
event.module:auditd AND process.name:(python3 OR python OR perl) AND process.args:("*socket*" OR "*connect*" OR "*subprocess*" OR "/bin/sh")

LNX - Defense Evasion (Linux).description: Detect history clearing, log deletion, binary hiding, timestomping on Linux.

commands.command: event.module:auditd AND process.args:("history -c" OR "HISTFILESIZE=0" OR "unset HISTFILE" OR "HISTSIZE=0")
event.module:auditd AND file.path:("/var/log/syslog" OR "/var/log/auth.log" OR "/var/log/secure") AND event.type:deletion
event.module:auditd AND process.name:touch AND process.args:"-t*"
event.module:auditd AND process.name:shred
event.module:auditd AND process.executable:("/tmp/*" OR "/dev/shm/*" OR "/run/user/*")

commands.description: utmp/wtmp tampered to hide logged-in users.
commands.command: event.module:auditd AND file.path:("/var/run/utmp" OR "/var/log/wtmp" OR "/var/log/lastlog") AND NOT process.name:(login OR sshd)

LNX - Defense Evasion (Linux).tuning: Alert on defense tool modification from non-privileged sources. Whitelist scheduled maintenance windows. Correlate with subsequent suspicious activity for context.

LNX - Container Threats (Linux).description: Detect container escape attempts and Docker misuse on Linux hosts.

commands.command: event.module:auditd AND process.name:docker AND process.args:("run" AND "--privileged")
event.module:auditd AND file.path:"/var/run/docker.sock" AND NOT process.name:(dockerd OR containerd OR docker)
event.module:auditd AND process.name:(nsenter OR unshare)
event.module:auditd AND file.path:"*/release_agent*"

commands.description: Container image pulled from unknown registry.
commands.command: event.module:docker AND event.action:pull AND NOT json.imageName:(*docker.io* OR *{company_registry}*)

LNX - Web Shell Detection.description: Detect web shells and webserver exploitation on Linux.

commands.description: PHP/JSP file written to web root by web server process.
commands.command: event.module:auditd AND file.path:("/var/www/html/*" OR "/srv/www/*" OR "/opt/tomcat/webapps/*") AND file.extension:(php OR jsp OR aspx) AND process.name:(apache2 OR nginx OR java)
event.module:auditd AND user.name:(www-data OR apache OR nginx) AND process.name:(bash OR sh OR dash)

commands.description: Suspicious web request with shell eval patterns.
commands.command: url.query:("*eval(*" OR "*system(*" OR "*exec(*" OR "*passthru(*" OR "*cmd=*")

commands.description: Curl or wget from web server user context.
commands.command: event.module:auditd AND user.name:(www-data OR apache) AND process.name:(curl OR wget)

commands.description: Reverse shell from web server process.
commands.command: event.module:auditd AND user.name:(www-data OR apache OR nginx) AND process.args:("/bin/bash" OR "/dev/tcp*" OR "nc -e")

LNX - Network Reconnaissance (Linux).description: Detect port scanning, network enumeration, and OSINT tools on Linux.

commands.command: event.module:auditd AND process.name:nmap
event.module:auditd AND process.name:(masscan OR zmap OR unicornscan)
event.module:auditd AND process.name:(curl OR wget) AND process.args:("169.254.169.254" OR "metadata.google.internal" OR "169.254.170.2")

commands.description: Rapid ping sweep — ICMP to many targets.
commands.command:
sequence by host.name, user.name with maxspan=1m

event.module:auditd AND process.name:(arp-scan OR netdiscover)

GCP Threats.description: Detect Google Cloud Platform threats via GCP audit logs ingested into Elastic — IAM abuse, service account impersonation, metadata exploitation, and Cloud Storage access.

commands.description: Detect GCP service account key creation (backdoor key for persistence)
commands.command:
event.dataset: "gcp.audit" and event.action: "google.iam.admin.v1.CreateServiceAccountKey"
| filter gcp.audit.authentication_info.principal_email: *
| fields gcp.audit.authentication_info.principal_email, gcp.audit.resource_name, @timestamp

commands.description: Detect GCP IAM policy bindings added with Editor or Owner role
commands.command:
event.dataset: "gcp.audit" and event.action: "SetIamPolicy"
and gcp.audit.request.policy.bindings.role: ("roles/owner" or "roles/editor")
| fields gcp.audit.authentication_info.principal_email, gcp.audit.resource_name, @timestamp

commands.description: Detect GCP compute metadata server access (IMDS token theft)
commands.command:
destination.ip: "169.254.169.254" and destination.port: 80
and url.path: ("/computeMetadata/v1/instance/service-accounts/default/token" or "/computeMetadata/v1/instance/attributes/startup-script")
| fields source.ip, process.name, url.path, host.name, @timestamp

commands.description: Detect GCP Cloud Storage bucket enumeration (list all buckets — recon indicator)
commands.command:
event.dataset: "gcp.audit" and event.action: "storage.buckets.list"
| stats count() by gcp.audit.authentication_info.principal_email, @timestamp
| where count > 5

commands.description: Detect GCP service account impersonation (actAs calls)
commands.command:
event.dataset: "gcp.audit" and event.action: "iam.serviceAccounts.actAs"
| fields gcp.audit.authentication_info.principal_email, gcp.audit.resource_name, event.outcome, @timestamp

WIN - RBCD & ADIDNS Detection.description: Detect Resource-Based Constrained Delegation setup (RBCD) via Event 5136 attribute modification and ADIDNS wildcard injection via DNS record creation events.

commands.description: Detect msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity attribute write (RBCD setup — Event 5136)
commands.command:
event.code: "5136" and winlog.event_data.AttributeLDAPDisplayName: "msDS-AllowedToActOnBehalfOfOtherIdentity"
| fields winlog.event_data.SubjectUserName, winlog.event_data.ObjectDN, winlog.event_data.OperationType, @timestamp

commands.description: Detect machine account creation (prerequisite for RBCD — Event 4741)
commands.command:
event.code: "4741"
| fields winlog.event_data.TargetUserName, winlog.event_data.SubjectUserName, winlog.event_data.SamAccountName, @timestamp
| where winlog.event_data.TargetUserName: *$

commands.description: Detect S4U2Proxy Kerberos service ticket requests (Event 4769 — suspicious SPN patterns)
commands.command:
event.code: "4769" and not winlog.event_data.ServiceName: ("*$" or "krbtgt" or "ldap/*")
and winlog.event_data.TicketOptions: "0x20000"
| stats count() by winlog.event_data.AccountName, winlog.event_data.ServiceName, @timestamp

commands.description: Detect ADIDNS wildcard record creation (Event 5137 — new DNS record object in DomainDnsZones)
commands.command:
event.code: "5137" and winlog.event_data.ObjectDN: "*DomainDnsZones*"
and winlog.event_data.ObjectClass: "dnsNode"
| fields winlog.event_data.SubjectUserName, winlog.event_data.ObjectDN, @timestamp

WIN - BEC & M365 Inbox Rule Detection.description: Detect Business Email Compromise (BEC) indicators — inbox forwarding rules, OAuth consent grants, and mass email exfiltration from compromised M365 accounts.

commands.description: Detect inbox rule creation with forward-to-external or delete (BEC persistence)
commands.command:
event.dataset: "o365.audit" and event.action: "New-InboxRule"
and (o365.audit.Parameters.ForwardTo: *@* or o365.audit.Parameters.DeleteMessage: "True")
| fields user.email, o365.audit.Parameters.ForwardTo, client.ip, @timestamp

commands.description: Detect OAuth application consent grants with high-privilege scopes
commands.command:
event.dataset: "azure.auditlogs" and event.action: "Consent to application"
and azure.auditlogs.properties.additional_details: ("Mail.ReadWrite" or "Mail.Send" or "Files.ReadWrite.All")
| fields azure.auditlogs.properties.initiated_by.user.userPrincipalName, event.action, @timestamp

commands.description: Detect impossible travel — same M365 account login from two countries within 1 hour
commands.command:
event.dataset: "azure.signinlogs" and event.outcome: "success"
| stats dc(geo.country_iso_code) as country_count, make_array(geo.country_iso_code) as countries by user.email, bin(@timestamp, 1h)
| where country_count > 1

commands.description: Detect M365 mail rule deleting messages matching 'fraud', 'wire', 'invoice' (BEC cover-up)
commands.command:
event.dataset: "o365.audit" and event.action: "New-InboxRule"
and (o365.audit.Parameters.SubjectContainsWords: ("fraud" or "wire" or "invoice" or "payment") and o365.audit.Parameters.DeleteMessage: "True")
| fields user.email, o365.audit.Parameters.SubjectContainsWords, @timestamp
